How Do Artists Get Discovered?

Spotify Apple Podcasts
B2

Show notes

In this episode of the Art of Artists podcast, we talk about how artists like Kid Cudi or Post Malone get started. We discuss some of the luck they experienced as well as what they used to get an advantage.
